title: Finding
description: One pitfall a datapitfalls review found in a piece of data work. Produced by the datapitfalls engine (detectPitfalls) and the datapitfalls agent's Debrief pass.

ruleId.description: An Avoiding Data Pitfalls rule id (kebab-case slug), e.g. multiple-comparisons.

nature.description: active: evident from the artifact itself. latent: depends on data the reviewer has not seen.

condition.description: For latent findings, the data condition under which the pitfall bites. Empty for active findings.

evidence.description: The specific evidence from the artifact (a quoted line, a chart element, or transcript events cited as [event N]).

consequence.description: Experimental: how much the finding changes the takeaway.

eventRefs.description: Transcript reviews only: zero-based event numbers the evidence cites.
